summary.text: Bill Ward is a Republican member of the North Carolina House of Representatives who has represented District 5 since 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
The General Assembly lists his occupation as retired law enforcement and describes his military service in the U.S. Army and Army Reserves.

paragraphs.text: Bill Ward was born in Elizabeth City, North Carolina, and Ballotpedia lists Central High School as his high school.
The General Assembly lists his military service as U.S. Army from 1974 to 1985 and U.S. Army Reserves from 1985 to 1990.
Ward assumed office in the North Carolina House on January 1, 2023, succeeding Howard Hunter III (D).
The General Assembly lists Camden, Gates, Hertford and Pasquotank counties for District 5 and a mailing address in Elizabeth City.
The Republican primary scheduled for March 3, 2026, was canceled.
